description: This file defines a view class 'OAuth2AuthCodesViewList' extending 'ViewList' for the OAuth2 authorization codes module in SuiteCRM. It customizes the preDisplay method to hide mass update fields and quick edit options on the list view.

classes.name: OAuth2AuthCodesViewList
classes.description: A custom view class for listing OAuth2 authorization codes, extending the base ViewList to modify the display settings.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to customize the list view before display, specifically hiding mass update and quick edit options.
